translator.note: i18n/ledger.json has no ui.notices row at this head (JSON scan: zero occurrences of 'ui.notices'), so translator identity is not derivable from repo artifacts. This audit is independent of the producing agents and read only the catalogue bytes.

findings.reason: 对{name}的回答 is the fixed Chinese collocation for 'the answer to {name}', which frames a conversation title as the question being answered; the three sibling receipts put the conversation in an adverbial slot (已向{name}发送回答 / 已拒绝{name}中的请求 / 已关闭{name}中的请求), and 中的 is the slot this key needs.

findings.current: 更新至版本{version}的安装仍在进行——现在打开应用会取消安装。{relaunch}点击此通知也不会让应用更早打开。
findings.proposed: 正在安装版本{version}的更新——现在打开应用会取消安装。{relaunch}点击此通知也不会让应用更早打开。
findings.reason: 更新至版本{version}的安装仍在进行 is a word-for-word nominalisation of English 'The update to version X is still installing'; Chinese states the ongoing act directly (正在安装版本X的更新), and the stacked 更新/版本/安装/进行 in an OS banner reads translated.

findings.current: 此安装无法安排自动重启，请在安装完成后手动启动Local Operator。
findings.proposed: 无法为此安装安排自动重启，请在安装完成后手动启动Local Operator。
findings.reason: 此安装无法安排自动重启 makes the installation the subject that 'cannot arrange', a calque of English 'No relaunch could be arranged for this install'; fronting 无法为此安装安排 restores the native construction. 自动重启 for an app relaunch matches the corpus's 重启应用, so no term change is proposed.

checks.detail: 93 English keys, 93 zh-CN keys, no missing and no extra; the target preserves the English order.

Parsed every message with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser from the worktree's shared node_modules: 0 parse failures. Argument sets are identical per key (name/title/keys/count/index/key/detail/reason/goal/version/origin/relaunch/existing/stored/published) with no argument added, dropped or renamed. Tags: none in either file. Number skeletons are byte-identical: {index, number} in credentials.removed and {count, number} in consent_body_many survive in the target.

checks.check: plural categories are the locale's CLDR set
checks.detail: Intl.PluralRules('zh-CN').resolvedOptions().pluralCategories = ['other']. Ten plural messages (config_run_changed, config_run_updated, drafts_offered_name, drafts_offered_verb, mark_all_read_cleared, mark_all_read_deferred, mark_all_read_superseded, mark_all_read_unknown, credentials.unconfirmed, credentials.unstored) use `other` only; no invented one/few/many arm. Every `other` arm carries {count}; drafts_offered_verb correctly receives {count} without printing it.
Formatted every zh-CN message with intl-messageformat at those counts; no render error. Examples: 配置操作已完成：1项定义已更改。 / 已将21个对话标记为已读。 / 1个凭据无法确认是否已存储（KEY_A,KEY_B）；已通知智能体在使用前先检查。

Brace-matched comparison of every message: no placeholder renamed, dropped or reordered. /credential, /goal, '<text>', bash, Aida, Local Operator and ID remain byte-identical Latin runs; zh-CN adds no placeholder of its own.

Zero zh-CN values equal their English source. The only Latin runs are the placeholders, Aida, bash, /credential, /goal, '<text>', Local Operator and ID - each a kept product/command/machine token per glossary §1. No English sentence survives.

你 throughout, zero 您 (matches the zh-CN guide's recorded decision). No 啦/哦/呀 particles and no ！. No 您/你 repetition; verb-forward phrasing in statuses (智能体已创建, 对话已清空). Four instruction strings use 请 (agents.save_unconfirmed, main.consent_body_many, main.consent_body_one, main.update_hold_no_relaunch); the guide's '请 only where English says please' clause is stricter than the corpus (181 existing imperative 请 against 6 English 'please' values), so this was recorded as a locale-wide observation, not counted as a finding.

Verified against the shared glossary and the 4,925 zh-CN values outside this namespace (5,018 including it): agent=智能体 (295 corpus hits), session=会话 (234), conversation=对话 (329), credential=凭据 (25), goal=目标 (52), draft=草稿 (9), archive=归档 (8), hub=中心 (上传到中心/从中心更新), approval=审批, site=网站, backend=后端 (46), prompt=提示词 (16), variable=变量 (19), configuration run=配置操作 (existing ui.hub.conflict.body), proactive/reactive=主动型/响应型 (existing ui.agents.refusals labels), seed=随机种子 (identical to ui.agents.settings.chat.error.invalid_seed), clear conversation=清空对话 (three existing keys), sign out=退出登录 (19), unread=未读 (5). dismiss=关闭 is the dominant corpus rendering (17 of 22 non-notices occurrences; three 忽略 for suggestions and one 不再显示此通知), so goal_dismiss_failed=无法关闭目标 is consistent, not drift.

Full-width prose punctuation throughout (，。：；、（）“”); 0 half-width commas/periods/colons adjacent to CJK outside placeholders; no straight double quotes; no '...' (only the source's command literal uses ASCII single quotes); no bidi controls or zero-width characters; NFC; no double spaces; no CJK-Latin/digit spaces inside any value. Terminal 。 follows the guide: dropped on short statuses (已创建{name}, 已保存{name}, 已创建文件“{name}”), kept on full sentences (including files.save_failed_gone, where English omits the stop). Latin acronyms stay uppercase (ID).
zh-CN is LTR; no RTL-specific requirement. Scanned for bidi controls and found none.

Cell-counted every value (CJK and full-width punctuation = 2): no zh-CN string is materially longer than its English source. The only value wider than English is ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_nothing at 18 cells vs 17 (+1). The two fixed tails are shorter than English (archive_offered_verb 8 vs 9 cells; drafts_offered_verb 8 vs 9), and their heads are shorter still (对话 4 cells; 21份草稿 8 cells vs '21 drafts' 9). OS banner bodies: update_hold_body 101 cells vs 151 English characters, consent_body_many 67 vs 84, consent_body_one 56 vs 71 — all under the sidecar's ~170/~250 limits. No rendered screenshot was taken; this is a cell/JSX-budget check only.

observations: All joined sentences read correctly as sentences at 1, 2, 5 and 21; the plural arms are grammatical for every count because zh-CN has no agreement.

The archive offer's title (flex/truncate) and the fixed verb tail compose correctly with the 4px gap; the verb is never the truncated half. The gap reads as a small space in Chinese, which is visually acceptable and is a design constant, not a catalogue string.

mark-all-read joins its sentence list with the ASCII space in mark-all-read.ts (message: [lead, ...remainder].join(" ")), so a Chinese toast containing a remainder renders as '…。 1个对话…' with a space after the full stop; archive_failed/unarchive_failed likewise append ' ' + detail in undo-toasts.tsx:254. Both are locale-neutral caller behaviour, not fixable in this catalogue and not counted as translation findings; a locale-aware join would be the source fix.

namespace_verdict: clean-with-findings - 93 of 93 keys read; 0 blocker, 0 major, 3 minor, 0 nit. The three minors are naturalness/precision in two OS-banner sentences and one named receipt (ZH-1..ZH-3); no accuracy, ICU, plural, placeholder, register, glossary or spacing defect was found.
overall_verdict: clean-with-findings (0 blocker, 0 major) - the zh-CN ui.notices translation is semantically faithful, ICU-intact, terminologically consistent with the existing zh-CN corpus, and typographically conformant; the three minors are recorded for a future polish pass, not churned in this audit.
notes: Source-call-site observation, not a translation finding: ui.notices.files.highlights_update_failed (无法更新重点文件。) is currently called from supplement-row.tsx's sendOp for supplements.cancel/restart/steer, not from a Highlights action. The English lead itself names Highlights at that call site; the zh-CN value uses the established 重点文件 term and faithfully translates the English. Flagged only as a source-copy/call-site mismatch outside this namespace's translation scope.

Source-level ICU observation, not a translation finding: ui.notices.chat.goal_done contains /goal '<text>'. ICU single quotes are quote toggles, so both the English and zh-CN messages render '/goal <text>' without the apostrophes (verified with intl-messageformat). The target preserves the source bytes exactly; if literal quotes are wanted, the English source needs doubled apostrophes first.
No catalogue, ledger, generated file or code was edited. This receipt is the only file written.
